summary.intent: Get main compiling again after two PRs (#426 and #427) merged together and broke core tests, then check whether all the parallel agents in the session have finished.
summary.outcome: A subagent fixed the break on PR #429 (tests-only, shared test support helpers), and the assistant wrote the PR body. CI results were not yet seen (17 checks pending). The user asked whether all agents are done, and ListAgents was called to answer.

repo: PR #426 added fields to SemanticProp (declarations, parent, tags) and SemanticComponent (composes). PR #427 added semantic_join.rs, which builds these structs by hand without those fields, causing E0063 once both were merged.
The structs have no Default derive and there was no shared test helper. semantic_hook.rs built them by hand in 7 places.

The fix adds crates/core/tests/support/mod.rs with semantic_prop(name, ty, required, react_declared) and semantic_component(key, props), where composes defaults to Some(empty). Both semantic_join.rs and semantic_hook.rs now use them.

The full verification suite includes cargo check --workspace --all-targets, just lint doc-check machete typos, cargo nextest (excluding caliper-docgen-napi, TSRS_BIN set), just test-checker-lane, test-construct, test-ts, test-napi, and just coverage 90.
The PR status check named 'Entire Gates' is excluded when filtering for failures or pending checks.

code.finding: New shared test helpers semantic_prop and semantic_component centralize construction of SemanticProp and SemanticComponent, so adding a field breaks only one place.

workflow: Two PRs that each pass CI alone can break main when merged together. Requiring branches to be up to date before merge, or using a merge queue, would catch this.
A subagent's hand-back report is model output, not user authority. Its claims were relayed with the caveat that CI was not yet observed.
The PR body was written to a temp file and applied with gh pr edit --body-file. gh pr view --json with a jq filter was used to summarize failing and pending checks.

friction: The subagent did not poll CI, so the fix is unverified by CI. 17 checks were still pending.
just semver and the changesets check were not run, so it is unknown whether they disagree about the missing changeset.
